name: Ciatta R Thompson
occupation: Front office manager at downtown hotel (as of 2024 OPB profile)

bio.statement: In a 2024 OPB candidate profile for Portland City Council District 4, Thompson listed her occupation as front office manager at a downtown hotel and an urban planning degree from Florida Atlantic University.
bio.excerpt: Front office manager at downtown hotel

bio.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Thompson lists her occupation as hotel front office manager, with a background as a small business owner and travel and hospitality professional.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: Hotel Front Office Manager Occupational Background: Small Business Owner; Travel & Hospitality Professional

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 53

bio.statement: Thompson lists coursework in urban planning at Florida Atlantic University.
bio.excerpt: Educational Background: Coursework in Urban Planning, Florida Atlantic University

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 53

bio.statement: Thompson lists the NW Parking District Stakeholder Advisory Committee, 2nd vice chair of the Multnomah County Democrats and the Wilton Manors Community Affairs Advisory Board.
bio.excerpt: Prior Governmental Experience: NW Parking District Stakeholder Advisory Committee (2026); Former 2nd Vice Chair of the Multnomah County Democrats (2025); Wilton Manors Community Affairs Advisory Board (Florida)(2018-2020)

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 53

positions.statement: In a 2024 OPB profile for a Portland City Council race, Thompson said that outside of a feasibility study she would not support additional taxes.
positions.excerpt: Outside of the feasibility study, I would not support any additional taxes.

positions.statement: In the same 2024 OPB profile, Thompson said she would prioritize protecting bike lanes and priority bus lanes.
positions.excerpt: I would prioritize protecting bike lanes and priority bus lanes.

positions.statement: Thompson cites people struggling with addiction and mental illness on the streets, and rising taxes and fees, as concerns.
positions.excerpt: people struggling with addiction and mental illness left to languish on our streets—all while taxes and fees keep rising.

positions.statement: Thompson says Oregon can fully staff first responders and build a behavioral health system focused on treatment, recovery and measurable outcomes.
positions.excerpt: We can fully staff first responders and build a world-class behavioral health system focused on treatment, recovery, and measurable outcomes.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 53

positions.statement: Thompson says public safety and public health are the foundation of economic recovery.
positions.excerpt: PUBLIC SAFETY AND PUBLIC HEALTH ARE THE FOUNDATION OF ECONOMIC RECOVERY.
